page.notes: The first word "lofophiam" is a fragment from the previous page (Philosophiam). "Sti" in "Spiritus Sti" is a superscript abbreviation that I could not read with certainty. The final word is split across the line as "emi-" / "nentissimo" and is written here as "eminentissimo" from the broken printed line. The running head "sana" is read from the scan and may be doubtful. The sentence numbers 17 and 18 stand inline in the text and are kept there as printed.
